additional_info.subject: RE: ID0420531-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / S2 313522141002]connector issue CRM:02681000102
additional_info.body:
Hi Ankita,
Your analysis is completely incorrect, and here’s why:
1st session (2025-05-06 at 07:15:49 UTC)
The session failed
after
the
ChargeParameterDiscovery
phase because
the EV never sent the Cable Check request
. So the failure is clearly due to the
EV’s behavior
, not the charging station.
2nd session (2025-05-06 at 07:18:13 UTC)
Charging started successfully with the EV at 71% SoC.
Current ramped up to 100A.
At 79%,
Dynamic Power Allocation
was triggered due to reduced power demand from the EV.
Then,
a non-critical error occurred on one power converter
, which caused the
EVSE max current to drop to 0A
.
The EV responded accordingly and set its target current to 0A.
The session then naturally terminated at 84% SoC.
A field intervention should be scheduled promptly to
replace the faulty power converter
, as it is clear that
the session only stops or the current drops to 0A after the power converter error occurs
—not before.
Please revise your assessment accordingly, based on these factual observations.
Best regards,
